using Raw = std::string
class Refusal : public std::runtime_error
  const char* word
  std::size_t offset
inline const std::vector<std::string> kFailureNames
struct Ref
  std::string store
  std::string digest
  std::int64_t size
  std::string locator
struct FindResult
  std::optional<Ref> reference
inline std::string encode(const Ref& v)
inline Ref decode(std::string_view data)
struct Store
  virtual std::string name()
  virtual FindResult find(const std::string& digest)
  virtual Ref place(const std::string& digest, const std::int64_t& size)
struct Local
  virtual std::string path(const Ref& reference)
struct Writable
  virtual void commit(const Ref& reference)
